description: This file defines the OfficeRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor for managing Office entities within the Fineract system. It includes a method to find an Office by its ExternalId.

classes.name: OfficeRepository
classes.description: Java interface acting as a repository for Office entities, allowing CRUD operations and specifications-based queries.

methods.name: findByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves an Office entity based on its ExternalId, returning an Optional that may contain the Office if found.
